description.short: Ask about your solar and storage plant on EnergyInCloud.
description.full: Ask about the solar and storage plants you own or installed on EnergyInCloud: production, consumption, self-consumption, self-sufficiency, savings, battery, connectivity, data quality and period reports. Answers come only from EnergyInCloud data, with the period and the units of each figure, and explain what a figure or an energy term means. Installers and distributors also see their fleet: connectivity, data quality, post-installation checks and fleet status. Sign in with your EnergyInCloud account; you see only the plants your account can access. The alarm list with details, plant settings and documents stay in the EnergyInCloud portal.
